title: Release Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0 RC2
summary: zhjwpku proposed release candidate 2 of Apache Iceberg C++ 0.3.0, based on commit b6508226. wgtmac and manuzhang voted +1 (non-binding). zeroshade voted -1 (binding): on Ubuntu 25.10 the verify script needed meson and gtest/gmock that are not listed as requirements, and linking libiceberg_rest.so failed because the libcurl pulled in through the cpr dependency was not built as position-independent code. zhjwpku replied that meson is not required and googletest should be fetched by CMake. kevinjqliu suggested running the verify script in a GitHub workflow; wgtmac said one already exists, viewed the problems as third-party dependency issues that should not block the release, and proposed making the script vendor third-party libraries. zhjwpku then aborted the vote, citing an issue in how cpr is resolved, addressed by iceberg-cpp PR #717, and announced an RC3 vote.

positions.stance: Votes -1 (binding) because the shared library link fails on Ubuntu 25.10 when the fetched libcurl is not built with position-independent code; the unlisted verify script requirements need not block.
Meson is not required since the verify script depends on CMake, and googletest should be made available automatically by FetchContent.
The reported problems are third-party dependency issues that should not block the release; the verify script should vendor third-party libraries and fail fast on an incompatible libcurl.
Use a GitHub workflow to run the verification script in a clean workspace.

outcome.note: The release manager aborted the vote because of an issue with how the cpr dependency is resolved; the fix went into RC3, for which a new vote thread was announced. Votes before the abort: two +1 non-binding and one -1 binding.
